data.name: SupplyHelp
data.value: Supply this container, preserving existing contents and declared initialization.

data.name: ClearHelp
data.value: Omit this answer. A string list item is reset to an empty string; use Remove item to remove its row.

data.name: ResetHelp
data.value: Remove the override and omission so declared initialization can apply. This does not copy an initialized value into supplied answers.

data.name: ImportLimitHelp
data.value: Local input, at most 4 MiB. Compare leaves current answers, drafts and prepared output untouched. Fill fields is deliberate and atomic.

data.value: Artifact: {0} | Compatibility: {1} | Execution completed: {2} | Coverage complete: {3} | Finding inventory complete: {4} | File eligible for autofill: {5}

data.value: Current workspace adoption: {0}. Target acceptance is unassessed. No historical rename, release or deployment provenance is established.

data.name: ImportSchemaHelp
data.value: Declared schema guidance only. This never selects or corrects a current row or map entry. Repair a separate copy of the imported file, or deliberately resolve workspace conflicts before filling fields.
